description: Tinny and Sicilus have provided a solution. A Narwhal horn is a natural conductor of the Essence. Find a Narwhal and kill it to harvest its horn. Follow the frozen river and head towards the Narwhal Bay to seek your prey.
name: Narwhal Bay
completed: Return to Tinny and Sicilus at the fork in the frozen river, they will know how to use the horn to destroy the barrier.

objectives.typeextra: Speak with Ernest at the Bay
